mechanism.artifact_A: immutable content-addressed object; create-if-absent is idempotent and an existing digest must verify the exact payload
mechanism.pointer_L: single canonical latest pointer with a monotonically changing version identity and atomic compare-and-swap from the caller's expected predecessor version
mechanism.restart_rule: read and hash-verify A and read L before any promotion retry; if L already targets A, return semantic success without another mutation; if L differs and predecessor identity is stale, fail closed
mechanism.application_fact: observable publication is the verified L target plus verified A payload; local success markers are derived bookkeeping only

tested_scope.writer_A: create A(payload_A), then promote expected_version=0 to A
tested_scope.competing_writer_B: create B(payload_B), then attempt promote expected_version=0 to B after A has won
required_traces: crash after A creation before L promotion
crash after successful L promotion before local confirmation
duplicate re-promotion of the same A
stale competing writer B using the superseded predecessor identity

stale_competing_writer.verdict: pass_for_latest_state_correctness; orphan cleanup not tested or required for publication correctness

result: Within this exact symbolic model, immutable artifact plus read-before-retry CAS pointer promotion makes observable latest-state publication idempotent across the tested crash windows and duplicate retry, while a stale competing writer fails closed. The pointer is the sole mutable publication authority; an orphan immutable losing artifact does not change the published latest state.
scope_guard: This is not evidence for stores lacking atomic compare-and-swap, read-after-write visibility, immutable/content-verifiable artifacts, or a single canonical pointer. It does not cover multi-pointer transactions, mutable artifacts, append/send/increment effects, ABA without version identities, pointer deletion/recreation, garbage collection, or external irreversible side effects before durable canonical state.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: role-local durable state transport only; no hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package quota, cloud compute, or external model/API execution is required by the tested state machine
mechanism_assessment.accepted_scope: two-object latest-state publication with immutable content-addressed artifact, versioned atomic CAS pointer, read/hash verification before retry, and the four tested traces
mechanism_assessment.unresolved_child: Test the same mechanism against ABA-style pointer identity reuse and corrupted/stale pointer reads; require a generation-qualified predecessor identity and fail-closed reconstruction without same-run polling.
